conditions: Serial production audits of the verified Docker app (proxy http://localhost:8080) with measurement browser/Node on the native host: installed Google Chrome via CHROME_PATH, native Node v24.14.1 spawning the installed frontend dependencies. LCP source optimizations (React.cache request deduplication on getTourDetail, CookieConsent bounding box reduction), Linux frontend gates (857 tests across 72 suites), and full Docker runtime verification preceded this attempt. Readiness used root redirects and API/UI smoke probes; no rebuild/restart/fixture refetch during audits. The unchanged about:blank CPU readiness hook runs before each URL with the same browser as the real audits; default Lighthouse mobile throttling remains configured.
